fusions.name: Mile Marker
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%).

fusions.name: Pace Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 7 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. It slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Road Legs
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds, and your movement speed rises 15% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Callused Gait
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster, and your physical resistance rises by 8%.
